calendar.$description: Calendar and ScheduleCalendar. Component tokens reference SEMANTIC tokens — by token path when the value is theme-agnostic, or through the semantic CSS variable (--qx-color-*) when it is theme-varying, so one declaration covers both themes. Qeet appears only where it means something: the selected day (and a range's two ends) is the solid action fill with its dark label, the days between them are the quiet brand tint, and today is a graphite marker (weight plus a dot), never a second orange.

cell-size.$description: One day cell, square. The density-resolved control height, so the grid tightens with compact density (28px) and opens up with comfortable (36px) exactly as the fields around it do.

day-corner.$description: A day is a chip-sized target, so it takes the chip corner — one radius for single days and for a range's end caps.

day-background-hover.$description: Hovering an unselected day: the neutral interactive fill, the same one a hovered menu item or ghost button uses.

selected-background.$description: The selected day and a range's two ends: the solid Qeet action fill. It is the one orange in the grid.

selected-foreground.$description: The dark label on the action fill (6.7:1). White on Qeet 500 is 3.0:1 and fails AA.

range-background.$description: The days between a range's ends: the library's selected tint, surface.brand-subtle, so the span reads as one selection without a band of solid orange. Dark brand-subtle is translucent, so the band stays visible on a picker's overlay surface (1.20:1); the private 14% mix this used to be is within ΔE00 1 of it in both themes.

range-background-hover.$description: Hovering a day inside the range: the selected-hover step every selected item uses.

outside-foreground.$description: Days from the neighbouring months. Still selectable, so still legible (AA) — just a step quieter than the month's own days.

disabled-foreground.$description: Days outside min/max or otherwise disabled. Always paired with a strike-through, so the state never rests on colour alone.

unavailable-background.$description: Days that exist but are taken (booked, blocked, a holiday): a sunken well behind the struck-through number, which separates 'unavailable' from 'out of range'.

event-background.$description: ScheduleCalendar's default event chip: a graphite chip, so a busy month does not turn orange. ScheduleEvent.color overrides it per event.

event-indicator.$description: The inline-start bar on a default event chip (≥3:1). The chip's only Qeet, and the cue that survives without the fill.

today-background.$description: ScheduleCalendar's today marker: an inverse graphite disc behind the date. Neutral, so 'today' never competes with selection or primary actions.
